newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL LEAVE OUT COSTA FOR GREECE GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL LEAVE OUT COSTA FOR GREECE GAME.

text.p: Fiorentina midfielder Rui Costa was the major absentee as Portugal named a virtually unchanged squad on Friday for a World Cup warm-up game against Greece on February 19.
There was no immediate explanation for Costa's absence from the 17-man squad chosen by coach Artur Jorge for the trip to Athens.
Jorge will be looking for a confidence-building performance after his talented but inconsistent team were soundly beaten 2-0 at home by France in a friendly last month.
Goalkeepers - Vitor Baia (Barcelona, Spain), Rui Correia (Braga)
Defenders - Jorge Costa (Porto), Fernando Couto (Barcelona) Dimas Teixeira (Juventus, Italy), Helder Cristovao (Deportivo Coruna, Spain), Carlos Secretario (Real Madrid, Spain).
Midfielders - Paulinho Santos (Porto), Sergio Conceicao (Porto), Rui Barros (Porto), Oceano Cruz (Sporting), Paulo Bento (Oviedo, Spain).
Forwards - Domingos Oliveira (Porto), Joao Vieira Pinto (Benfica), Ricardo Sa Pinto (Sporting), Jorge Cadete (Celtic, Scotland), Luis Figo (Barcelona, Spain).
